name: model-router
description: Haiku judges each subagent task and moves easy ones to a cheaper model. Never changes the main chat.

lightModel.title: Light model
lightModel.description: Runs subagent tasks that leave little to judgment and are cheap to get wrong.

standardModel.title: Standard model
standardModel.description: Runs tasks with a clear goal that still need real reasoning.

heavyModel.title: Heavy model
heavyModel.description: Runs tasks whose goal or cause is unclear, or where a hidden mistake would do harm.

lowerBar.title: Bar to go cheaper
lowerBar.description: How sure the judge must be (0 to 1) before a task runs on a cheaper model than its parent.

raiseBar.title: Bar to go stronger
raiseBar.description: How sure the judge must be (0 to 1) before a task runs on a stronger model than its parent.

timeoutMs.title: Judge time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.description: After this long without a verdict, the subagent starts unchanged.
